date.as_written: pakṣavānanandagoyute samvate || āṣāḍhakṛṣṇatrayodasyān tithau dine || ... śrīśāke 1816 śrīsamvat 1951 nepālīsamvat 1015 miti caitravadi 8 roja

notes: The colophon contains two dates: a chronogram date in verse (pakṣavāṇanandagoyute saṃvate āṣāḍhakṛṣṇatrayodasyān) and an explicit date at the end giving Śāke 1816, VS 1951, NS 1015, Caitra vadi 8. The author name ācāryyabharibhadra is a corrupt form of Ācārya Haribhadra.
